label: Actualized through: dependence reading versus act reading
resolution: ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1 (DeflatedActualizedBy) reads 'r is actual in x through esse' as 'x has r in act and has being'; ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2 (the field ActualizationFrame.ActualizedBy) is the act reading, esse as the act by which r is actual. Both have type B → R → R → Prop, so the Lean types and bind-check do not enforce the distinction; only these definition records state it. The q.4 a.1 ad 3 unde route is sense-neutral: ractOneFromDependence, ractTwoFromDependence and the load map are generic in the frame, so they hold with ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1, on which the first bridge DependenceIsActualization is analytic (undeLoadMap, conjunct 4). The act reading therefore does no work on this route; its separating content is reception, plus inclusion for R-act2 (docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md).
